projectsList.title: Club Motatawi3 Sefrou — Volunteer Platform
projectsList.description: Web platform for the Sefrou volunteering club: a bilingual showcase (Arabic RTL / French) and a member area for volunteers. It unifies sign-up, profile completion, activity and event management, and full club administration.
features: Bilingual public site (Arabic RTL / French) with light and dark themes, built with Next.js (App Router).

logsoc.context: Supervising IT systems means continuously centralizing and analyzing large volumes of logs. LogSOC was built for that need: a single platform to collect, analyze and detect anomalies in system logs, with AI to speed up diagnosis.
logsoc.role: Design and development of LogSOC, an intelligent monitoring and web system supervision platform, during my internship at Attijariwafa Bank.
logsoc.solution: Containerized full-stack architecture: a Flask REST API (SQLAlchemy, async processing, job scheduler) and an Angular 17 SPA with Tailwind CSS. Analyses come from three sources — remote servers over SSH, local files and scheduled jobs. Google Gemini scores threats and produces a security score; reports are exported to PDF and emailed. Everything is orchestrated with Docker Compose (PostgreSQL, backend, frontend) behind Nginx.
challenges: Analyze logs from multiple sources without switching tools: remote SSH, local files and scheduled jobs.
Secure access: encrypted connection credentials, hashed passwords (bcrypt) and signed tokens.
Integrate AI threat evaluation (Google Gemini) with a security score and risk summary.
Reproduce the full environment in containers (database, API, frontend) for a controlled deployment.
logsoc.results: Platform deployed and tested in a local environment via Docker Compose (PostgreSQL database, Flask API, Angular front-end).

motatawi3.context: The Sefrou volunteering club, founded in September 2026, had no digital tooling: sign-ups, activity tracking and communication were all handled manually. It needed a single, bilingual, mobile-friendly platform.
motatawi3.role: Full design and development, solo: architecture, front-end and back-end, database and security, emails and deployment.
motatawi3.solution: Bilingual Next.js (App Router) application (Arabic RTL / French) with light/dark themes. Writes go through secured Server Actions. Supabase handles accounts and the PostgreSQL database, Sanity stores activities and events, Resend sends notifications. An /admin area centralizes club management.
challenges: Unified sign-up: Google account or email code (6 digits), then mandatory profile completion (parental consent for minors).
Shared client and server validation with React Hook Form and Zod, from a single schema checked on both sides.
Secure by default: RLS enabled on every table, explicit grants, service_role key kept server-side only.
Role hierarchy enforced in the database and on the server: a super admin only acts on accounts they promoted themselves, never on a founder.
